verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing page claims '70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate,' which supports HRIS sync for equity data, but there is no documentation naming Gusto/Rippling specifically, no detail on how new hires/terminations automatically flow into equity records, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: specific HRIS connectors (Gusto/Rippling) named, documented workflow for hire/termination sync into equity records, third-party verification of the integration working.
